tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Sport-Thieme product by its article number, including description, available variants, price, availability and ratings.

articleNumber.description: The article (variant) number of the product, as returned by search_products.

tools.name: navigate_to_product
tools.description: Open the product detail page for a given article number in the current browser tab. Use this when the user wants to view or buy a specific product.

articleNumber.description: The article (variant) number of the product to open, as returned by search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Sport-Thieme product catalog by free-text keyword (for example "football", "gym mat") or by article number. Returns a list of matching products including name, brand, price, availability and a link to the product page.

searchTerm.description: The keyword or article number to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1 to 24, defaults to 8).
